narr: A slowly approaching cold front triggered numerous clusters of thunderstorms across central Illinois during the evening of September 3rd into the early morning of September 4th. Some of the storms produced locally heavy rainfall of 2 to 3 inches and isolated flash flooding. The hardest hit location was Decatur, where widespread street flooding occurred.
ev: Extensive urban flooding was reported across Decatur. Several streets were closed due to high water. Vehicles were stranded in flood waters, requiring a few water rescues.
lsr: EXTENSIVE URBAN FLOODING. SEVERAL STREET CLOSURES. MULTIPLE VEHICLES STALLED IN FLOOD WATERS ACROSS THE CITY.
